name: yuanbao_media_parse_webp_size
notes: WebP dimension parse traced on hex-encoded buffers. Agreed sub-contract: >=30-byte buffers only. KNOWN DIVERGENCES (documented, excluded): buffers of 16..29 bytes (LIVE parses VP8L at >=25 and VP8 with markers, C requires >=30); VP8X chunks (LIVE parses extended format, C has no branch); malformed VP8 marker bytes (LIVE validates the 0x9D01002A frame tag, C does not).
